name: twindesk-demo
description: Renders docs/demo.gif from real twindesk output recorded on macOS.

scripts.social: node make-data.mjs && remotion still src/index.ts Social ../social-preview.png
scripts.render: node make-data.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Demo out/demo.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i out/demo.mp4 -vf "fps=15,scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=128:stats_mode=diff[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=4:diff_mode=rectangle" ../demo.gif
